id: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle (2004)

ops.old: Vanilla ice cream blended with malted milk powder, cold milk and salted caramel, poured into tall glasses streaked with caramel and topped with whipped cream. Make salted caramel: melt 100g sugar until amber, whisk in 80ml cream and 20g butter, then half a tsp salt, and cool. Drizzle some inside 4 tall glasses. Blend 1L vanilla ice cream with 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 3 tbsp of the caramel until thick. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream and a drizzle more caramel.
